quotes.quote: users can leverage Qwen2-Audio to analyze a diverse range of audio types, including speech, sound, music, or various mixed audio forms

R5: No pricing or cost-per-minute information, nor any comparison to Whisper or other ASR APIs, appears in the provided chunks: unknown.

Overall, the evidence confirms rich audio analysis and voice chat capabilities and broad evaluation, but does not cover the specific integration questions about sound event detection granularity, speaker diarization, user fine-tuning, barge-in, or cost.
